name: JPM-05: Member exits the donation group and loses access (SL-4)

steps.name: MEMBER: Exit Group from the room Settings tab (was: Donation-Based)
The group room tab bar should render — if it does not, this member has no access to the group getByRole('tab', { name: 'Settings', exact: true })

"Exit Group" should be offered on the Settings tab of the group room. If it is missing, either this member is not a member of "PW_Group_20261021_084754_w3r0462pe4", or the control moved — re-run the room tab walk before changing this locator. getByRole('button', { name: 'Exit Group', exact: true }).first()
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: 'Exit Group', exact: true }).first()
Scroll into view getByRole('button', { name: 'Exit Group', exact: true }).first()
Click getByRole('button', { name: 'Exit Group', exact: true }).first()
Clicking "Exit Group" should open the "Leave Group" confirmation locator('[data-testid="group-leave-modal"], [role="dialog"][aria-label="Leave Group"]').first()

The leave dialog should ask "Why do you want to leave this group?" locator('[data-testid="group-leave-modal"], [role="dialog"][aria-label="Leave Group"]').first().getByText('Why do you want to leave this group?')

The leave dialog should offer a reason field — it is required, and Continue does nothing while it is empty locator('[data-testid="group-leave-modal"], [role="dialog"][aria-label="Leave Group"]').first().locator('textarea').first()
Fill "Automated test run — leaving to re-join at a different price." locator('[data-testid="group-leave-modal"], [role="dialog"][aria-label="Leave Group"]').first().locator('textarea').first()

"Continue with leaving group" should be enabled once a reason is given locator('[data-testid="group-leave-modal"], [role="dialog"][aria-label="Leave Group"]').first().getByRole('button', { name: 'Continue with leaving group', exact: true })
Wait for selector locator('[data-testid="group-leave-modal"], [role="dialog"][aria-label="Leave Group"]').first().getByRole('button', { name: 'Continue with leaving group', exact: true })
Scroll into view locator('[data-testid="group-leave-modal"], [role="dialog"][aria-label="Leave Group"]').first().getByRole('button', { name: 'Continue with leaving group', exact: true })
Click locator('[data-testid="group-leave-modal"], [role="dialog"][aria-label="Leave Group"]').first().getByRole('button', { name: 'Continue with leaving group', exact: true })

The "Leave Group" dialog should close once a reason is given and "Continue with leaving group" is clicked. If it is still open, the form rejected the submission — read the validation message rather than raising the timeout. locator('[data-testid="group-leave-modal"], [role="dialog"][aria-label="Leave Group"]').first()
